shift: Combined aggression + defense limit changes from 1.4 to 0.8; contract version changes. Pure policy invalidates; hybrid abstains before execution and uses the model with current rules.
comparison: Paired identical initial seeds, one action and equal wall-time limits per episode. Arm order rotates by seed index. Both model and synthesizer receive identical public scoring formulas; neither sees heldout results before the policy freezes. Refinement uses only training seeds. No post-holdout tuning.
pricing: Subscription-backed Pi OAuth. Dollar marginal cost and subscription allocation are unknown. Report measured model calls, input/output/cache tokens and wall time; provider usage cost is informational only, not invoiced spend. Stop before a new call after observed token threshold; Pi CLI cannot enforce an API max-output token cap, so the final call may cross that threshold.
go_rule: A supported-contract pilot qualifies for further investigation only if policy/hybrid mean score >= 0.75, paired bootstrap lower bound for score difference vs model >= -0.02, no illegal actions/errors on supported cases, and measured resource amortization improves by horizon 100. Shifted cases must explicitly invalidate or abstain. This does not authorize production promotion.
limitations: One synthesis run, one model and a one-step parameter-scoring simulator. State-dependent advantages are not established. Bootstrap intervals describe seed variation conditional on the frozen policy, not synthesis/model reliability. Horizons beyond observed tasks are projections, not measured executions. No claims about arbitrary game play or open-world tasks. TypeScript parity deferred.
transport: Pi invoked with tools/extensions/context files disabled, ephemeral sessions, and local retry.enabled=false/retry.provider.maxRetries=0. Application-level invalid-action retries count toward the 28-invocation budget. Provider-side internal accounting beyond reported usage is not independently observable.
amendment: Before any successful model inference or heldout evaluation: initial gpt-5.4-mini call rejected as unsupported for ChatGPT subscription. Switch to gpt-5.5. Carry failed call, prior four training evaluations, and elapsed setup into accounting. Combined invocation limit remains 28.
